title: Thermochemical Cycles
description: Heat is a state function: the heat of a reaction is the same whatever route it takes, so it can be added up from reactions already measured. Unlocks the Heat-Pack Reactor, ammonium nitrate and the cold packs.

puzzle.goal: Carbon burns to carbon monoxide (heat a), carbon monoxide to carbon dioxide (heat b); a third reaction gives back c. Write the heat h of the whole route, start to end.
puzzle.name: Hess
puzzle.ask: Find h in kJ/mol for a = −110.5, b = −283.0 and c = 0.
puzzle.method: Enthalpy is a state function: add the steps of any route; a step run backwards counts with its sign changed.
